repository.description: Repository of the image, without the tag.

pullPolicy.description: When Kubernetes pulls the image: `Always`, `IfNotPresent` or `Never`.

tag.description: Tag of the image. Pin it by digest, as `<version>@sha256:<digest>`.

description: An image: repository, tag and pull policy. A container selects an image by the name of its key on the root of the values, with `imageSelector`.
